entries.why: These deprecated methods remain callable for compatibility but do nothing. Do not follow their stale preferred name to another deprecated API.
entries.when_ok: Only inert compatibility calls; never depend on them to reset orientation.

entries.old: Model.breakJoints / Model.makeJoints / Model.move / Model.moveTo / BasePart.breakJoints / BasePart.makeJoints
entries.new: Explicit WeldConstraint lifecycle for joints; Model:MoveTo(position) when its collision-adjusting semantics are intended, PivotTo for an exact transform
entries.why: Lowercase aliases are deprecated. Uppercase MakeJoints/BreakJoints are also deprecated, so do not stop at a spelling change.
entries.when_ok: Existing movement aliases can remain until touched; preserve MoveTo collision/offset behaviour.

entries.new: Update ExcludeInstances or IncludeInstances on the matching parameter object
entries.why: AddToFilter mutates the superseded FilterDescendantsInstances list, whose meaning depended on FilterType.
entries.when_ok: Existing correctly configured filters can remain; migrate the list and mode together.

entries.new: Use ExcludeInstances / IncludeInstances explicitly on RaycastParams or OverlapParams
entries.why: FilterType is superseded along with FilterDescendantsInstances. Exclude and Include enum items still exist for compatibility.
entries.when_ok: A working old-style filter can remain; changing only the mode or only the list can change query results.

entries.why: The old method returns coordinates; GetWaypoints supplies structured waypoints including jump actions.
entries.when_ok: Existing simple paths can migrate gradually; update loops to read .Position.

entries.new: Remove the ineffective setting; pass supported agent parameters to PathfindingService:CreatePath
entries.why: EmptyCutoff belonged to the removed legacy voxel pathfinding system.
entries.when_ok: Only inert legacy settings; do not tune modern pathfinding through it.

entries.new: part.CollisionGroup for membership/name; PhysicsService:GetRegisteredCollisionGroups() for registered groups
entries.why: Collision groups use names on BasePart; legacy numeric IDs and enumeration methods are deprecated.
entries.when_ok: Working callers may migrate gradually; update table consumers and persisted group references deliberately.

entries.why: The documented current API names unregistration explicitly.
entries.when_ok: Untouched compatibility calls; verify the group is no longer needed before unregistering it.

entries.new: Terrain:ReadVoxels / WriteVoxels or FillBlock with Enum.Material.Water
entries.why: Legacy cell-based water APIs belong to the removed terrain engine. Smooth terrain uses material and occupancy volumes.
entries.when_ok: Never for current terrain generation; migration must convert cell coordinates and resolution deliberately.

entries.new: Remove legacy smooth/voxel migration branches; use current terrain read/write APIs
entries.why: The legacy terrain engine is removed. Terrain.IsSmooth is always true; these conversion-era flags/functions are obsolete.
entries.when_ok: Only inert compatibility checks during removal of old content.

entries.new: Remove this obsolete setting; measure current replication/rendering behaviour before tuning supported systems
entries.why: The deprecated setting no longer takes effect and writing it is PluginSecurity, not a game-script capability.
entries.when_ok: Only inert saved legacy settings; never a runtime performance toggle.

entries.new: gcinfo() for Luau heap usage in KB; use engine profiling tools for broader memory
entries.why: Roblox only permits collectgarbage("count"); other operations cannot control the engine collector. The documented alternative is gcinfo.
entries.when_ok: Existing collectgarbage("count") measurements; never assume collect/stop can force or disable GC.

entries.old: Object.className / Object.isA / Instance.archivable / Instance.childAdded / Instance.children / Instance.isDescendantOf
entries.new: ClassName / IsA / Archivable / ChildAdded / GetChildren / IsDescendantOf
entries.why: These compatibility aliases use the modern member with the same receiver and operation.
entries.when_ok: Untouched working legacy code.

entries.old: BoolValue.changed / BrickColorValue.changed / CFrameValue.changed / Color3Value.changed / IntValue.changed / NumberValue.changed / ObjectValue.changed / RayValue.changed / StringValue.changed / Vector3Value.changed
entries.why: Lowercase changed is deprecated. ValueBase-derived Changed signals supply the new value rather than a property-name string.
entries.when_ok: Working compatibility listeners; preserve handler argument assumptions.
entries.notes: A receiver named value is not proof of a ValueBase; check its type.

entries.why: Modern tag-based discovery and lifecycle signals replace the old collection API. The old class/collection argument is not automatically the new tag.
entries.when_ok: A legacy collection can remain during an explicit tag rollout.
entries.notes: Tag existing instances, enumerate once, then bind added/removed signals and cleanup.

entries.why: The methods moved to Animator; resolve the same server-created Animator that owns the tracks.
entries.when_ok: Read-only legacy tooling can migrate gradually.

entries.why: The animation event belongs to the Animator that owns playback.
entries.when_ok: Existing observers can migrate when the rig lifecycle is updated.

entries.why: The synchronous methods are deprecated; use the yielding asynchronous API and handle failures.
entries.when_ok: Existing tooling can migrate gradually after checking call context and asset permissions.
entries.notes: Verify API security before moving provider calls from a plugin into game code.

entries.why: The old clip loads can freeze while loading; the documented Async variants yield instead.
entries.when_ok: Existing tooling can migrate gradually after checking permissions and failure paths.

entries.old: AvatarEditorService.CheckApplyDefaultClothing / AvatarEditorService.ConformToAvatarRules / AvatarEditorService.GetAvatarRules / AvatarEditorService.GetBatchItemDetails / AvatarEditorService.GetFavorite / AvatarEditorService.GetInventory / AvatarEditorService.GetItemDetails / AvatarEditorService.GetOutfitDetails / AvatarEditorService.GetOutfits / AvatarEditorService.GetRecommendedAssets / AvatarEditorService.GetRecommendedBundles / AvatarEditorService.SearchCatalog
entries.new: Use each same-named AvatarEditorService method with the Async suffix
entries.why: The pinned docs document same-behaviour Async renames. Preserve arguments, returned pages/data and existing inventory permission checks.
entries.when_ok: Working old callers can migrate as one reviewed rename set.

entries.why: The character-loading method has an Async rename; loading replaces the character and yields.
entries.when_ok: Working old calls can migrate with the respawn lifecycle.

entries.why: These yielding avatar methods have explicit Async names in the current API.
entries.when_ok: Working old calls can migrate after preserving parameters and error handling.

entries.why: Use the Async rename while keeping reset semantics; ApplyDescriptionAsync is not a drop-in replacement for the reset variant.
entries.when_ok: A working old reset path can migrate gradually with avatar tests.

entries.new: GroupService:GetRolesInGroupAsync(userId, groupId); check the documented roles result
entries.why: Even the first-generation Async rank/role methods are deprecated because a user can hold multiple public roles.
entries.when_ok: Existing single-role displays can remain if their semantics are intentional; authorization must handle the complete result deliberately.
entries.notes: Do not blindly take the first role or compare the returned container to a number/string.

entries.new: CharacterAppearanceId for the avatar source; HumanoidDescription APIs and Humanoid:ApplyDescriptionAsync for appearance changes
entries.why: URL- and instance-based appearance APIs are deprecated. The replacement depends on whether you set the avatar source, fetch a description or apply a specific accessory.
entries.when_ok: Legacy character assembly can remain until a rig/appearance migration is tested.

entries.why: Use the current explicit query and event for character appearance readiness.
entries.when_ok: Untouched compatibility checks; connect before relying on a one-time event and handle already-loaded characters.

entries.old: Players.NumPlayers / Players.getPlayers / Players.localPlayer / Players.numPlayers / Players.playerFromCharacter / Players.players
entries.why: Lowercase compatibility aliases and NumPlayers are deprecated. LocalPlayer is client-only.
entries.when_ok: Untouched working code, provided the client/server context remains correct.

entries.why: The lowercase userId property is a deprecated compatibility alias.
entries.when_ok: Untouched working code; keep stored IDs numeric and do not substitute display names.

entries.why: The method-style accessors are deprecated; use the documented axis properties.
entries.when_ok: Existing accessors can migrate gradually; preserve object-space versus world-space intent.

entries.why: The Rotation names are deprecated in favor of Orientation names. Preserve local versus world space and verify Euler-angle behaviour.
entries.when_ok: Untouched legacy attachments whose orientation is stable.

entries.why: SpreadAngle replaces the deprecated scalar cone spread with two angular dimensions.
entries.when_ok: Existing effects can remain until their appearance is compared; the mapping is not a universal visual equivalence.

entries.why: The yielding translator lookup has the explicit Async name.
entries.when_ok: Working callers can migrate gradually with fallback translations and failure handling.

entries.new: GetEntries / SetEntries / GetTranslator / RemoveEntry / SetEntryValue as appropriate
entries.why: The legacy table APIs used different data/access shapes. Modern entries and Translator APIs require a deliberate argument/result migration.
entries.when_ok: Offline localization tooling can remain until its export/import round trip is checked.
entries.notes: Not a name-only edit: read each replacement signature and preserve keys, context, source and locale values.

entries.new: LocalizationTable.SourceLocaleId; set GuiBase2d.RootLocalizationTable on the intended UI root
entries.why: The source locale belongs to the table. Current UI-root localization assigns the table from the UI object instead of assigning a target root from the table.
entries.when_ok: Existing localization content can migrate after checking table ownership and fallback behaviour.

entries.why: AutoLocalize is the current property name for automatic UI localization.
entries.when_ok: Untouched compatibility settings.

entries.new: GuiObject.SelectionGroup and explicit selection navigation properties
entries.why: SelectionGroup supersedes the old named selection-group registry. Tree-based and tuple-based selection require different layout/navigation choices.
entries.when_ok: Existing gamepad menus can remain until focus navigation is compared on a controller.

entries.new: LayoutOrder or Name sorting with Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder / Name
entries.why: Custom comparator sorting is deprecated. Compute stable LayoutOrder values when the intended order is more complex than names.
entries.when_ok: Existing layouts can remain while a deterministic ordering migration is checked.

entries.new: VRService:GetUserCFrame / VRService.UserCFrameChanged; request Enum.UserCFrame.Head for head pose
entries.why: VR pose APIs moved to VRService. The deprecated head property points through another superseded input-service API.
entries.when_ok: Existing VR code can migrate with device tests and coordinate-space checks.

entries.why: The old touch movement modes are deprecated and the docs recommend DynamicThumbstick.
entries.when_ok: Existing saved settings only while touch controls are tested; the replacement changes interaction behaviour.

entries.why: The current enum names make primary-axis alignment explicit.
entries.when_ok: Untouched compatibility settings; verify constraint axis orientation.

entries.why: The old fidelity property is deprecated in favor of an explicit acoustic-simulation enable flag.
entries.when_ok: An existing authored setup can remain until acoustic behaviour is compared; do not assign an enum to the new boolean.

entries.why: The current API corrects the capital T in AudioSubType.
entries.when_ok: Untouched working compatibility queries.

entries.why: Deprecated service aliases should become explicit service retrieval; do not assume lowercase service properties exist for every service.
entries.when_ok: Untouched working compatibility access.

entries.why: BindToClose allows shutdown callbacks instead of the deprecated single OnClose callback. Shutdown remains time bounded.
entries.when_ok: Untouched existing callback only until a reviewed save lifecycle is in place.
entries.notes: Coordinate with PlayerRemoving and ongoing saves; do not duplicate writes or promise unlimited shutdown time.

entries.why: The old VIP names are deprecated aliases for current private-server metadata.
entries.when_ok: Untouched compatibility reads; a nonempty ID alone does not imply a player-owned private server.

entries.why: These lowercase members are deprecated aliases. Existing Sound-based systems remain supported.
entries.when_ok: Untouched working audio; no need to redesign a stable Sound system just for these aliases.

entries.why: The asset-search methods have Async renames. Search results are not authorization to load or execute untrusted asset code.
entries.when_ok: Existing search tooling can migrate gradually with yield/error handling.

entries.why: The documented replacement methods use Async names; preserve their paging and asset-permission semantics.
entries.when_ok: Existing tooling can migrate gradually after checking security context.

ranking.scope: All 704 pinned deprecated/superseded API rows; editorial priority, not measured popularity or model failure frequency.
ranking.evidence_status: provisional; no public/tutorial corpus or generated-model-output sample
